title: Value of a singleton Walsh character
statement:
Fix a dimension $n$, a coordinate $i \in [n]$, and a point $x$ of the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$. Then the Walsh--Fourier character of the singleton set $\{i\}$, evaluated at $x$, is the sign encoding of the $i$-th coordinate of $x$:
\[
  \chi_{\{i\}}(x) \;=\; \sigma(x_i).
\]
hypotheses_covered: point x of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
